page_summary: This page discusses the thematic areas of cybersecurity in ports, focusing on the current state of cybersecurity approaches and best practices. It includes prompts for understanding the governance structures and policies that guide port cybersecurity, as well as inquiries about innovative practices and the role of leadership in enabling cybersecurity progress.
